The 990’s original designers were tasked with creating the single best running shoe on the market. In 1982, finished product more than lived up to its billing. For avid runners and ahead of the curve tastemakers alike, the 990 was a mark of quality and superior taste. There have been updates to the design since then, and more color options, but the 990’s aspirational status symbol aura has never changed. Simply put, the 990 is the shoe so good, that New Balance has never stopped making it. The MADE in USA 990v4, originally introduced in 2016, continued to refine the v3's modernization of the silhouette. p-howlerbros-8288821739635.d:
THE YELLOW ROSE 10TH ANNIVERSARY COLLECTION
Ten years ago, we joined forces with Austin City Limits Music Festival to make apparel celebrating one of the country’s most iconic music festivals happening right here in our own backyard. A decade, a whole lot of music and more than a few collectable pieces later, we’re still at it. This year’s Yellow Rose Collection celebrates our tenth Howler Brothers for Austin City Limits Music Festival endeavor with nods to where we’ve been and some new tricks for where we’re headed. Here’s to ten years. Turn it up!
Our desire to make the Gaucho Snapshirt is one of the reasons we started Howler Brothers in the first place. We wanted to transform the vintage western shirts of the past into something technical and wearable in everyday life while maintaining a little of their quirky nature and penchant for unique, embroidered artwork. We succeeded in a big way by making ours out of lightweight, quick drying blended fabric and adding a cooling mesh-lined vented back yoke to keep it cool when the temperatures are cooking. We threw in pleated chest pockets, pearl snaps, and an ever-evolving slate of custom embroidery.

p-howlerbros-8288824393843.d: We took our corduroy Depot Jacket and added a layer of high pile fleece lining to give it a little throwback vibe and a wealth of toasty warmth. The Fuzzy Depot Jacket will be your best friend at the football tailgater and moontower beer bust when the chilly wind is blowing. El Camino not included.

p-howlerbros-8288827768947.d: The brand new High Rider Shirt is a 100% cotton take on a classic western with prints that give a nostalgic nod to 90's ranch wear. Perfect for ropin' the wind and doing the boot scootin' boogie from Austin to Amsterdam.

p-howlerbros-8169956081779.d: Your favorite volley-style shorts just got an upgrade for spring 2026. We kept all cool retro styling but upgraded the fabric and added a built-in mesh compression liner for all-day comfort in and out of the water. Quick drying, stretchy, and packed with details like mesh draining pockets and a bungee loop, these trunks are ready for jump serves, surf checks, and spontaneous swims.
